description: Boruta, the devil nobleman of Polish legends, a huge broad-shouldered devil lunging forward with a curved silver sabre, one wide chunky shape filling the whole picture, a bold simple silhouette, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, a big horned red devil head taking a large part of the picture, two thick curved black horns, a wide white grin, bright glowing yellow eyes, a pointed black beard, a small dark fur cap with no feather, a simple green kontusz coat with one wide gold sash, a thick red devil tail with a black tuft, one black goat hoof and one red boot, menacing, full body, three-quarter view, the creature alone, no rocks, no ground, no background, the whole creature inside the picture, the whole sabre inside the picture
